Name: Johannes Schneider

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Electrical Engineering Intern, Siemens AG. Assisted the engineering team in designing circuit layouts for industrial automation equipment. Conducted tests on prototype devices to ensure compliance with safety and performance standards. Supported senior engineers by preparing technical documentation and schematic diagrams for ongoing projects. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot electrical faults and propose effective solutions. Participated in weekly meetings to present progress updates and discuss project milestones, demonstrating strong communication and teamwork skills.

Education:
- 2019--2023: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Technische Universität München. Main courses: Circuit Theory, Power Electronics, Digital Signal Processing, Control Systems, Electromagnetic Fields, Microcontrollers and Embedded Syst
